title: Two explicit adapters behind one narrow real seam
description: Separate fixture-qualified layout variability from the stable ingestion protocol without creating a generic parser platform.
decision: IStatementAdapter exposes immutable Descriptor, structural Probe(PdfDocumentEvidence), and Extract(PdfDocumentEvidence, exact released AccountDetail). Register only pdf-text-layout-a-v1 and pdf-text-layout-b-v1; exactly one probe must match. Each adapter owns its proven row boundaries, Source Row Identity, dates, balance-movement direction, exclusions, controls, and FinancialEvidence. Preview alone applies AccountDetail.AccountClass through FinancialNormalizer and then StatementReconciler. No wrapper/private account lookup, dynamic loading, rule language, OCR fallback, generic table parser, or cross-layout branch is allowed.
rationale: Two independently qualified adapters make this a real seam. Deleting it would smear detection and row semantics into preview orchestration. A single conditional parser grows into an untestable switch; regex or template configuration turns finance semantics into unreviewed data; per-bank child processes add lifecycle and distribution complexity. C7 and NG4 require the narrow registry.
alternatives: A: one conditional parser, rejected because detection and extraction drift together. B: user-authored regex or template rules, rejected because unreviewed configuration would own financial semantics. C: dynamic plugins or child processes, rejected as unsupported deployment and security complexity. D: two explicit adapters behind IStatementAdapter, chosen because two real implementations exist.
consequences: Every advertised variant needs representative golden fixtures, exclusive detection, deterministic bounded extraction, and versioned identity. A new format is a new adapter plus evidence. AccountDetail stays authoritative. metadataFingerprint is SHA-256 over adapter version plus normalized layout-specific statement account metadata in source order; paths, filenames, selected accountId, transaction rows, and financial values are excluded.
status_notes: Accepted; bd-1as preflight bound the seam to released AccountDetail, preserved existing normalization/reconciliation ownership, and defined the privacy-safe metadata fingerprint required by private evidence.
